pitches.subject: Aero Veil — “Carbon Bloom”
pitches.body:
Hi Basement Frequency,

I’m sharing one track, “Carbon Bloom,” an industrial techno piece built around metallic textures from my home studio. Its dark, driving, raw feel seemed like a fit for your coverage.

Listen: https://example.com/aero

Best,
Aero Veil
